subject: Personnel onboarding continuity artifacts — evidence request
messages:
From: Anjali Desai <anjali@helix-consulting.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Personnel onboarding continuity artifacts — evidence request

Hi Jasmine,

Lumin's audit team is preparing the SOC 2 sampling for Redwood and we need a set of artifacts to validate onboarding/offboarding, background checks, and continuous security training for a rolling sample from Jul 2026 — Mar 2028.

Would you please provide the following for a sample of ~10 employees (we can accept redacted PII):
- consolidated training matrix (completion dates, course IDs, version)
- manifest of background checks (redacted, with check type and pass/fail & date)
- access provisioning/deprovisioning log for the same cohort (timestamps and roles)

Deadline: we are hoping to collect these by Thu, 22 Mar 2028 EOD. If you prefer to share via a secure Drive link or DocuSign envelope, that's fine. Please also include point-of-contact for attestations if required.

Thanks in advance,

Anjali Desai
Senior Security Assessor
Helix Consulting
anjali@helix-consulting.com

Attachment: none

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Anjali Desai <anjali@helix-consulting.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Personnel onboarding continuity artifacts — evidence request

Hi Anjali,

Thanks for the heads up — we can provide those artifacts. A few quick clarifications so we give you exactly what you need:
- Do you want a randomized sample of 10 employees across orgs, or a targeted sample (e.g., recent contractors + full-time hires)?
- For background checks, we will provide a redacted CSV (no SSNs) showing check type, date, and result. Is that acceptable?
- For access logs, do you need raw audit events or an exported provisioning/deprovisioning report grouped by user?

Plan: I will coordinate with HR and Security Ops to pull the training matrix and BG manifest and have Marissa drop the redacted files into a secure Drive folder. Vivek, can you pull the provisioning/deprovisioning extract for the requested cohort? If we can confirm scope today, we’ll aim to upload to the shared Drive and send a DocuSign envelope for manager attestations by Wed EOD.

CCing Vivek and Marissa to jump in.

Cheers,

Jasmine Liu
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachment: none

Folks — forwarding Anjali's request from Helix (SOC2 lead). Goal: deliver redacted artifacts to the Drive link below and confirm attestations by Thu EOD. High priority for this week.

Ask breakdown:
- Marissa: pull consolidated Training Matrix (course id, completion date, version) covering Jul 2026—Mar 2028 for a randomized sample of 10 employees across Eng, Product, and Sales. Produce: training_matrix_2027_v2.pdf. Redact emails/IDs if needed. Put in the Drive folder and mark file as "redwood/compliance/soc2/2028-03".
- Vivek: export provisioning/deprovisioning events for the same cohort (include timestamp, actor, role change, and deprovision timestamp). Prefer XLSX: onboarding_access_log_2028-03-01.xlsx.
- Marissa: also produce a redacted background checks manifest (manifest must show check type, date, pass/fail; omit PII): redacted_bg_checks_manifest.csv. Flag any incomplete checks — Helix might request follow-up.

Rules: avoid including PII (SSNs, DOBs). If you need legal redaction guidance, loop Karthik. If we cannot meet Thu EOD, propose latest ETA now.

Drive link for upload: https://redwood.app/drive/Shared/onboarding-evidence-2028
DocuSign (if needed): https://docusign.com/abc123

Thanks — Jasmine

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Thank you — we received the Drive upload and the redacted CSV and matrix. The artifacts look good and the redactions are acceptable for sampling.

One outstanding ask: for the sampled rows (we will target the 10 indicated), we need manager sign-off attestations that the hires were properly onboarded and that access was removed where applicable. A simple signed form (DocuSign or PDF with manager name, title, employee ID reference, and signature) is sufficient.

Can you confirm if you can provide manager attestations for the 10 sampled employees by Sat, 24 Mar 2028? If so, please upload to the same Drive folder or route via the DocuSign link.
